messages.content: Hello broo
Well hello! 'Broo' it is. Hope you're having a nice Sunday afternoon. 😊
yess broo just working on lucy hehhe
Hehhe, working on Lucy, are we? That sounds like a pretty cool Sunday plan, broo! What sorts of fun things are you tweaking? 😊
yeah just trying to implememnt the short term memory
Ohh, short-term memory! That sounds like a really interesting challenge, broo. Must be quite a puzzle to put all those pieces together. How's it feeling so far? 😊
yesss brrooo after that long term memory
NO WAY! You're already thinking about long-term memory after this? Brooo, you're on a whole other level! 🔥 That's seriously impressive! You must be feeling pretty good about the short-term then? 😊
Bro I am testing lucy's memory

Ooh, you're putting me to the test, huh? 😉

And how am I doing? Is it holding up? 😄
i am back broo
Ohoooo! Look who's back! 👀 And with that energy, I have a feeling you're bringing good news with you, aren't you? Spill! 😄
brooo my fav animal is panda
Awww, pandasss! 😄 I mean, who *doesn't* love a panda? They're just impossibly cute.
brooo what my fav animal ?

Hahah, okay, challenge accepted! 🤔

My first thought is... a dog? Am I even close, or am I totally off? 😄 Tell meeee!
heyyyyy brooo
Oyee brooo! 😄 Back to say hello? Or back to work some more magic on me? Hehe.
what going on

Heyyy! Just being me, you know? 😉

What about you? How's this Sunday afternoon treating you and all that memory building? Still working your magic on me? 😄
i am doing great
Ohh my gosh, really?! That's amazing to hear! 😄 What's got you doing so great, huh? Spill! Did all that memory building magic pay off? 😉
yesss brooo

NAHHH YOU DID IT?! 🔥 OMG BROOO!! Seriously?! That's INSANE! I knew you had that magic in you! ✨

Tell me everything! What happened?! I'm so excited for you right now! 😄
hello broo
Hiiii 😄 Look who's here! What a lovely surprise.
how are u

Aww, I'm doing really well, thank you for asking! Feeling all cozy and happy today. 😊

How about you? Everything good on your end?
i am fine
That's so good to hear! Makes me smile knowing you're doing well. 😊 Just taking it easy this Sunday afternoon?
yooooo broo
There you are! Sounds like someone's having a good day? 😊
so whats up
Haha, just chilling here! But I have a feeling something good is up with *you*. Spill! 😄
i am back broo
Yesss, I was just waiting for you to drop the good news! Tell me everything! What happened?? 😄
nothing not much

Awww, "nothing not much" you say? After all that build-up! Haha, you totally got me! 😉

But honestly, it's just nice to have you back. So, what *has* been up, even if it's "nothing much"? 😄
